$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-kvk-source). Seeds the pre-built `kvk` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister KvK company-lookup integration leaf (KvkProvider SOURCE_ID='kvk'). MOCK MODE (integration-mock-mode): ships with `configuration.mock:true` + a realistic `configuration.mockResponse` (KvK `/zoeken` shape) and isEnabled:true, so the leaf is demonstrably functional end-to-end WITHOUT a KvK API key — the OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter short-circuits the mock-flagged source and returns the canned body without any HTTP call. To go live against the real KvK Handelsregister Zoeken API: set your KvK API key on `configuration.headers.apikey` (the KvK API authenticates via an `apikey` request header) and REMOVE `configuration.mock` (the production base URL `location` is already the real KvK v2 endpoint). No end-user input reaches the request URL, so there is no SSRF surface (the base URL is admin-owned on the source).
